directionSummary: Grounded Welcome: a restrained, typography-led public practice website using warm paper, deep plum, clear humanist type, and open left-aligned composition. Help prospective patients and caregivers understand care and request contact without implying real-time booking. Designer-selected proposal, awaiting approval.

brand.mood: An approachable, composed public front door, neither a clinical system nor a luxury spa.
brand.scene: A prospective patient or caregiver reading on a phone in daylight between other tasks needs legible information and a direct, low-pressure route to contact.

palette.strategy: Restrained: paper dominates; plum is concentrated on actions, links, and limited identity details. No pure white or black. Verify contrast in rendered states.

typography.display: Source Sans 3, upright, weight 600; same family for Harbor Wellness text wordmark.
typography.body: Source Sans 3, weight 400; labels and actions 600; system-ui, sans-serif fallback.
notes: Prefer self-hosted files with font-display: swap; no required remote font service.
Body 18px/1.55, supporting text 16px, input text minimum 16px.
Heading steps approximately 24, 32, 40px; hero fluid 40–64px with 1.08 line-height; other headings 1.2.
Left-aligned sentence case. Headline width about 18–22ch and prose width about 60–68ch.
No decorative italic treatment, very light weights, all-caps paragraphs, or gradient text.

layout.direction: Mobile-first public-site composition with open rows, quiet rules, and an asymmetrical text-led opening on wide screens.
layout.navigation: Non-sticky top header: Harbor Wellness linked home, Services, Request an appointment. Small-screen labeled Menu reveals an inline region, not an overlay. Section links cover existing visitor information and FAQs without new destinations.
layout.density: Spacious with concise content and tight related groups; no oversized empty hero viewport.
notes: Content width maximum 1120px; gutters 20px phone, 32px tablet, 48px wide desktop.
Spacing scale 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 88px; section separation 48–88px, varied intentionally.
Home opening pairs a dominant heading, explanation, primary CTA, and services link with a narrower text-only request-process explanation on wide screens; stack in reading order on mobile.
Service summaries use open rows and horizontal rules; practical guidance and a contact prompt follow. No repeated icon-card grid.
Services content uses readable sections; request and receipt use the same public shell with a form column up to 600px.
Switch navigation near 720px or earlier if content requires. Expose aria-expanded; support Escape and focus return when closing from inside.
Footer contains only approved practical details and available navigation. No sign-in, sidebar, caregiver portal, or unbuilt destination links.
No horizontal page scrolling at 320px or 200% zoom; allow wrapping, preserve reading order, and never hide essential content on mobile.

surfaces: Prefer unboxed sections and 1px horizontal rules.
Use surface panels only for meaningful form or feedback grouping; no nesting.
Control radius 8px; necessary panel radius at most 12px.
No decorative shadows, gradients, glass effects, colored side stripes, or blank pseudo-image panels.
forms: Single-column native controls, visible labels above inputs, minimum 48px height, 20–24px between fields.
Required requestor name, required preferred contact method, required corresponding email or phone; do not require both channels.
Optional broad service interest includes an undecided option. Choices must be approved or clearly marked preview placeholders.
Caregivers enter their own contact information; no additional patient identity or relationship questions.
No free-text reason, symptoms, history, insurance, dates, attachments, or availability picker.
Explain that submission requests contact, not a booked appointment, and ask visitors not to include medical information.
Validate on blur after interaction and on submit; no restrictive name pattern; allow international phone numbers.
Errors appear below controls with aria-describedby and aria-invalid. Focus first invalid field after submit.
Preserve values in page memory on validation/network errors; no persistent browser storage for form data.
actions: Primary filled plum with porcelain text; minimum 48px height. Information-page CTA: Request an appointment. Form CTA: Send request.
Secondary actions are clear text links; underline links in prose. Full-width submit on narrow screens.
Do not disable the untouched form because fields are empty; show clear validation on submit.
Sending request… reflects actual pending submission and prevents duplicate presses. Readable disabled styling with explanatory text when unavailable.
Distinct hover, focus, pressed, and disabled states. No hover-dependent access to content.
dataDisplay: Plain-language service sections, short lists, and approved practical visitor details.
Native disclosures may support FAQs in existing public sections.
No dashboards, metrics, fabricated trust badges, testimonials, outcome claims, or provider directory.

principles: 140–180ms color or opacity transitions with ease-out; no animated layout.
No autoplay, parallax, bounce, scroll choreography, or mandatory entrance animations.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; state changes remain understandable without motion.
Pending feedback is tied to real work, not a staged delay.

accessibility.target: WCAG 2.2 AA design requirements; not a certification.
principles: Verify 4.5:1 normal text contrast and 3:1 large text and essential control/focus contrast.
3px plum focus outline with 3px offset; porcelain inner separation on plum buttons.
Touch targets at least 44px, preferably 48px. Keyboard access, skip link, semantic landmarks, logical headings, and visible focus throughout.
Announce pending and result states accessibly; associate labels, helper text, and errors with fields.
On real receipt navigation, move focus to the confirmation heading. Errors retain form values and provide retry.

requestFeedback.pending: Sending request… while the actual submission is outstanding; block duplicate presses.
requestFeedback.successGate: Only positive server acknowledgment of a durably accepted request. Never use a timer, optimistic success, or an unguarded confirmation URL.
requestFeedback.receiptMeaning: The practice will contact the visitor. No appointment has been booked. Do not promise a response time without practice approval.
requestFeedback.failure: Show an honest, retryable inline error and retain values in page memory. Unavailable submission is not success.
requestFeedback.privacy: Do not put contact details in URLs or echo them in public receipt content.

contentAndAssets.identity: Harbor Wellness is the roadmap working practice name. Use a simple text wordmark without inventing a practice emblem.
contentAndAssets.favicon: Preserve the existing user-selected Specode PNG favicon. This does not make Specode the full practice brand.
contentAndAssets.imagery: No new required assets. A deliberate typography-led layout carries identity, without stock clinician, stethoscope, or spa imagery. Future photos must be authentic and approved.
contentAndAssets.content: Clearly identify neutral preview placeholders until practice-approved descriptions, services, practical visitor details, contact/location/hours, and follow-up expectations are supplied.
prohibitions: No invented actual provider facts, credentials, specialties, addresses, testimonials, availability, outcomes, or compliance claims.
No actionable placeholder phone/email/address links. Replace unverified content before public launch.

constraints: Public education and basic no-account appointment requests only; requests are not bookings.
Do not introduce admin, accounts, calendar, payments, messaging, provider directory, integrations, sensitive intake, or MFA.
Preserve existing Secure HttpOnly authentication scaffold without auth changes, credential-storage bridges, or persistent session caches.
Keep authentication scaffold out of the public navigation and request journey.

references.label: Source Sans 3 typography catalog
references.rationale: Catalog reference for the font family; not a user-selected brand reference or practice fact.
